translations: (the) Messenger (of) Allah an excellent example an excellent example
(in) Allah and the Day the Last
puzzle.hint: This verse highlights Prophet Muhammad ﷺ as the supreme role model for believers who hope in Allah and the Last Day.
puzzle.arabic: لَّقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِى رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌۭ لِّمَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَ وَذَكَرَ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًۭا
puzzle.verseEn: There has certainly been for you in the Messenger of Allāh an excellent pattern for anyone whose hope is in Allāh and the Last Day and [who] remembers Allāh often.
